'''Minalod''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] who was the leader of the [[Vermilic]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Minalod lived at the [[Floating Palace]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Carnovia]] and he kidnapped various [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] from among the Hutt [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Species/Legends|species]] to produce cheap counterfeit versions of popular processed foodstuffs.<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" />
